items.headline: MU fell 7.0% on 4 Nov to close at $795.23 (from $855.10; low $782.00, ~35.1M shares) as memory stocks sold off on worries that Democratic midterm wins, including Texas, could slow the AI data-center buildout; SK hynix fell ~5.4% and SanDisk over 8% (MarketBeat; Invezz, 2026-11-04)

TrendForce (third-party est.) weekly spot: DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s spot dipped 0.09% to $46.82 (3 Nov) from $46.86, as spot sits above suppliers' official quotes and buyers wait for a correction; some DDR5 buyers raised target prices under delivery pressure; 512Gb TLC NAND wafer spot fell 4.33% to $16.152 (TrendForce, 2026-11-04)

Micron roadmap detail: it has dropped 4F² DRAM cells (unlike CXMT, Samsung, SK hynix) in favour of wafer bonding, High-NA EUV and eventually 3D DRAM; 1δ DRAM volume production planned for 2H 2027; standard and custom HBM4E, then custom HBM5E and vertically stacked vHBM on top of ASICs (Tom's Hardware, 2026-11-04)

Samsung DS (₩10.65T) and SK hynix (₩8.33T) Q3 operating profit totalled ~₩19T, driven by price rather than volume (Samsung DRAM/NAND ASP +20%/+17% QoQ vs bits +3%/+4%, Hana Securities est.); Korea Investment & Securities (est.) sees SK hynix Q4 DRAM/NAND prices +18%/+13% QoQ (Yonhap Infomax, 2026-11-04)

Mixed memory signals: Kioxia guided only ~1% QoQ December-quarter revenue growth (stronger yen, order timing, mix; still sees supply tight through 2027) while Apple guided gross margin to 45–46% largely on higher memory costs and expects prices to keep rising beyond December (BigGo Finance, 2026-11-04)
MU closed $855.10 on 2026-11-03, -7.9% vs $928.76 on 2026-10-27 (Nasdaq.com official closes)

MU rebounded 2.6% on 3 Nov to close at $855.10 (from $833.59; range $845.25–$871.49, ~20.7M shares, about half average volume) as chip stocks bounced after Monday's selloff; ~$865 after hours (MarketBeat, 2026-11-03)

Counterpoint Research (third-party est.) projects HBM4 unit price rising from ~$2/Gb now to ~$4/Gb in 2027; TrendForce (est.) sees 2027 HBM ASP +121%. DRAMeXchange: PC DDR4 8Gb module fixed price $27.50 on 30 Oct (~4x a year ago), so commodity DRAM currently out-earns HBM; Samsung and SK hynix say 2027 HBM volumes and prices are settled (Edaily (citing Counterpoint Research, TrendForce, DRAMeXchange), 2026-11-03)

Samsung (-5.0% to ₩217,500) and SK hynix (-5.5% to ₩1,391,000) fell over 5% early on 3 Nov, giving back 2 Nov gains as US tech weakness and AI-capex return worries spread; KOSPI slipped back below 5,700. KB Securities raised Samsung's 2027 operating-profit estimate 15% to ₩640T (HBM ASP +150% est.) (Aju Press (Korea Exchange data), 2026-11-03)

Memory names led the 3 Nov rebound after Apple said rising memory costs are squeezing its gross margin and expects memory prices to keep climbing into next year, read as confirmation the pricing upcycle is intact; Micron may lift buybacks after CHIPS Act restrictions lapse around 9 Dec (reported) (Investing.com, 2026-11-03)

Memory chip prices have roughly doubled in a year; Micron, Samsung and SK hynix are prioritising data-center customers over PC and consumer makers, and the Korean firms are locking in five-year supply deals (Nikkei report) (Semafor (citing Nikkei), 2026-11-03)

US Commerce has not approved SK hynix's export licenses for tools to expand its Dalian, China plant, complicating Solidigm's planned ~$45B NAND fabs in Marcy, New York (sources); Under Secretary Kessler held that no US tools may upgrade or expand China capacity (Reuters via Investing.com, 2026-11-03)

Smugglers reportedly bring Samsung/SK hynix HBM into China by co-packaging it with weak processors to exploit a BIS rule exemption; Huawei's Ascend 960DT faces an HBM shortage, and CXMT's HBM3E yields are reportedly only 20–30% vs ~70% at SK hynix (TrendForce (citing The Information, Reuters), 2026-11-03)

NVIDIA has reportedly asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to use TSMC 3nm for the base dies of its custom NVHBM (unveiled in August), to standardise performance and validation across suppliers (report, unconfirmed) (Global Advanced Packaging (citing Seoul Economic Daily), 2026-11-03)

MU traded ~1–2% higher pre-market on 2 Nov ($903.35 at 07:20 ET; $893.88 at 08:32 ET) vs the $884.74 close on 30 Oct as US futures recovered from Friday's tech sell-off; the regular session opens 22:30 SGT (Robinhood real-time quote / StockAnalysis, 2026-11-02)

MU fell ~5.8% on 2 Nov to ~$833 (Nasdaq last sale $833.06; open ~$890.66, low $829.24, ~29M shares) after an early gain faded, extending the 30 Oct -5.3% drop; memory/storage peers SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate fell ~6–8% as Kioxia's soft guide and AI-capex worries hit chips (chip stocks lost over $400B of market value on the day, per Investing.com) (Robinhood real-time quote (Nasdaq last sale) / MarketBeat, 2026-11-02)

Kioxia guided December-quarter operating profit to ¥2.0T vs ~¥2.35T consensus (Sep quarter ¥1.99T), implying nearly flat NAND pricing after mid-20% ASP growth in the Sep quarter (70% in the June quarter); it blamed shipment timing, said 2027 output is sold out and over half of 2028 allocated; shares fell as much as 15% in Tokyo on 2 Nov (Bloomberg (via CNBC-TV18 / The Japan Times), 2026-11-02)

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman made a surprise weekend visit to Korea, meeting ~50 Samsung executives in Yongin and SK Group's Chey Tae-won with SK hynix executives; no new agreements were announced. The report cites TrendForce (third-party est.) forecasting HBM blended ASP up 121% in 2027 vs 2026 (The Korea Herald, 2026-11-02)

KOSPI rebounded 2.24% to 5,859.08 on 2 Nov; SK hynix closed +3.81% at ₩1,472,000 and Samsung +1.78% at ₩229,000. SK hynix began buying back 14.92M shares on 29 Oct (through 28 Jan 2027), about 500k (~₩734B) executed so far (Yonhap / Yonhap Infomax, 2026-11-02)

CXMT plans to send customers samples of its first server-grade DRAM on 4F² architecture by end-2026 (earnings-briefing summary released 31 Oct); no mass-production timeline was given, and SCMP frames 4F² as a route around US equipment curbs that Micron has chosen to bypass (South China Morning Post, 2026-11-02)

TrendForce Weekly Radar (third-party, 2 Nov): DRAM lead times eased to 19 weeks but supply stays 'Very Tight', especially 32GB/64GB RDIMMs; GPU supply moves from Balanced to Tightening as the Rubin transition begins (TrendForce Weekly Radar 008, 2026-11-02)

Long-term supply agreements spread: SK hynix has LTAs with 14 customers (mostly ~5-year terms) covering over half of its 2027–28 capacity, with DRAM/HBM effectively sold out through 2029; Samsung has 10 signed, 10 more in talks, and is targeting 60–70% of capacity under LTAs by 2030. TrendForce (est.) sees new fabs adding meaningful DRAM supply around 2028 (Korea JoongAng Daily, 2026-11-02)

KB Securities (third-party est.) keeps sector 'Positive', expects a W-shaped memory-stock rebound starting Nov–Dec; forecasts 2027 commodity DRAM prices +40%, NAND +32% and HBM +121% year over year (Financial News (fnnews), 2026-11-02)

Korea October 2026 chip exports $56.44B (+259.4% YoY, second-highest month after September's $60.3B); memory exports $50.14B (+360.5%). Ministry fixed-price series: DDR5 16Gb $48.0 (Sep) to $50.0 (Oct); NAND 128Gb flat at $30.6 (Korea MOTIR / Korea JoongAng Daily, 2026-11-01)

CXMT says it has completed engineering-sample validation of a sixth-generation DRAM platform on 4F² cell architecture, with mass production to follow gradually on customer validation and demand; it pushed back on Micron's view that capacitor spacing limits 4F² density gains (Seoul Economic Daily (Yicai via Reuters-Yonhap), 2026-11-01)

MU closed -5.30% at $884.74 on 30 Oct (range $861.59–$906.54, 30.5M shares) as the Nasdaq fell ~2.2% on Amazon and AI-capex worries, with CXMT's results adding pressure; ~$889 after hours (Nasdaq close (MarketMinute) / MarketBeat, 2026-10-30)

Sandisk FQ1 FY27: revenue $11.03B (+23% QoQ, ~60% volume / ~40% price) and non-GAAP EPS $49.51 beat (~$10.7B / ~$47.15 expected); gross margin 85.1%; data-centre revenue +61% QoQ to $4.8B; FQ2 guide $12.2–12.6B. On the call it said NAND prices should keep rising modestly through FY27, bits stay allocated beyond CY2027, and long-term agreements cover ~50% of 2027 bits; announced an 8-for-1 split. Shares fell ~2.6% after hours (Sandisk (press release / Investing.com call transcript), 2026-10-30)

Amazon held 2026 cash capex at ~$220B (Q3 $75.9B, mostly AWS and AI) and expects to spend 'meaningfully more' in 2027; trailing free cash flow -$42.4B. After Microsoft's trim and Alphabet's hold, all three hyperscalers still point to higher 2027 spending (Amazon / CNBC, 2026-10-30)

MU closed -4.98% at $934.27 on 29 Oct (range $927.24–$971.01, 21.6M shares) as Samsung's net-profit miss and Alphabet's slide weighed on memory stocks, giving back most of the 28 Oct gain (Nasdaq close (MarketMinute), 2026-10-30)

Intel guided 4Q26 below expectations, saying soaring memory prices are cutting PC demand; CFO Zinsner said Intel is 'not optimistic about next year in terms of memory' and does not expect supply to improve in 2027, and it will shift Panther Lake laptop capacity to Granite Rapids server CPUs. Intel shares fell ~21–25%, a demand-destruction signal for PC DRAM/NAND (Zero One digest (Intel 29 Oct call), 2026-10-30)

MU opened ~5.5% lower on 30 Oct (~$883 at 09:33 ET vs $934.27 close) in a broad tech sell-off: Amazon fell ~7% premarket on a Q3 miss and a second quarter of negative free cash flow (Q3 capex ~$77B, ~$20B above estimates) and Intel ~25% on its guide; Sandisk, SK hynix ADR, WDC and STX also lower despite Sandisk's beat. No Micron-specific news (CNBC / TipRanks, 2026-10-30)

Samsung has signed memory long-term supply agreements with 10 major customers and is negotiating with 10 more, with LTA demand spreading from hyperscalers, OEMs and SoC makers to mobile, automotive and networking; Samsung says 2027 HBM is sold out at target prices and tight supply will persist into 2028 (Electronic Times (etnews), 2026-10-30)

CXMT Q3 2026: revenue RMB 118.71B (+613% YoY, +19.3% QoQ, slowing from +95.9% in Q2), attributable net profit RMB 54.4B (+3% QoQ), gross margin 89.5%; sixth-generation DRAM samples completed validation; RMB 1-2B buyback approved. Its first results since the July IPO fed CXMT competition worries in memory stocks (The Standard (Reuters) / Invezz, 2026-10-30)

TrendForce (third-party, 30 Oct): consumer DRAM contract gains narrowed to flat-to-slightly up in October as buyers turn cautious into year-end; spot prices have fallen markedly from peaks and decoupled from contract, with some legacy chips now trading below contract; it still expects contract shortages and gradual quarterly increases in 2027 (TrendForce (Specialty DRAM Price, Oct 2026), 2026-10-30)

Samsung Q3 2026: record revenue ₩195.3T and operating profit ₩107.4T (chip division ₩106.5T), broadly in line with LSEG, but net profit ₩75.1T missed (~₩86T FactSet) and shareholder-return details were pushed to late January; shares fell 4.1% in Seoul. Samsung expects 2027 AI memory demand to 'far exceed' industry supply (Samsung Newsroom / CNBC, 2026-10-29)

Samsung Q3 call: DRAM ASP rose ~20% QoQ and NAND ASP high teens; HBM4 revenue more than tripled QoQ to ~60% of HBM sales, HBM share now on par with its DRAM share; 2027 HBM volumes sold out at target prices; HBM4E mass production 1H27; Q4 bit growth guided mid-to-high teens for DRAM, mid-teens for NAND (The Asia Business Daily (Samsung call), 2026-10-29)

MU fell ~3% early on 29 Oct (~$955 vs $983.23 close) as Samsung's net-profit miss and Alphabet's post-earnings drop hit memory peers (SanDisk, SK hynix ADR also lower); SanDisk reports FQ1 FY27 after the US close tonight (Investing.com, 2026-10-29)
